test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

__Unless we are not sure__ of our goals, we cannot achieve them.

options.text: Except if we are not sure

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Unless we are sure'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'Unless we are not sure' **should be changed into** 'Unless we are sure'.**
 
• We use the **conjunction** '**unless**' to mean &a
